instruction: The input directory contains two Altium OutJob files: `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\assembly.OutJob` (with 2 `[OutputGroupN]` sections and `VariantName=Std`) and `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\fabrication.OutJob` (with 3 `[OutputGroupN]` sections and `VariantName=Mfg`). Merge them into a single `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\release.OutJob` with the following rules: - Keep only one `[OutputJobFile]` header section. You may reuse the version from `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\assembly.OutJob`. - Concatenate all `[OutputGroupN]` sections in order: first the 2 sections from `assembly`, then the 3 sections from `fabrication`. After concatenation, renumber them continuously as `OutputGroup1..OutputGroup5`. - Preserve every internal `key=value` line inside each group exactly as-is, including fields such as `Name`, `TargetOutputMedium`, `VariantName`, `OutputMediumN...`, and `OutputTypeN...`. Only the section numbers may change. - Each group's `VariantName` must stay as it was in its original source file; do not overwrite them with a single common value. Write the merged result to `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\release.OutJob`.
source: task.md #7 (Altium "Three Ways To Simplify Output Generation" blog post)
